extracted.name: Stuffed Acorn Squash
extracted.description: Acorn squash halves are filled with butter, brown sugar, stuffing mix, chicken broth and savory spices, and baked. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups dry bread stuffing mix, divided
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Place squash, face up, in a shallow baking dish. In each half place 2 tablespoons butter, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 cup stuffing mix, 3/4 cup chicken broth, salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder. Wrap each half tightly with aluminum foil.
Bake in preheated oven for 60 minutes, or until squash is very tender.
